# Third-party software

- KaTeX 0.16.22, MIT. Source: https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX/tree/v0.16.22 . Local license: katex/LICENSE. Used for LaTeX to native MathML. Included in standalone exports with license notice.
- Gifsicle Wasm Browser 1.5.19, MIT wrapper. Source and embedded worker: https://github.com/renzhezhilu/gifsicle-wasm-browser . Local license: gifsicle/LICENSE. Its WebAssembly engine is based on Gifsicle 1.92: https://github.com/kohler/gifsicle/tree/v1.92 . Gifsicle is distributed under GPL-2.0-or-later; see gifsicle/GIFSICLE-COPYING. Build sources are available in those upstream repositories. No vendor code has been modified; the application's worker supplies a DOM-free type helper when invoking the wrapper.
- Nunito, Roboto, Open Sans and Noto Sans: SIL Open Font License. Local licenses: ../assets/fonts/*-OFL.txt.
